quote: Buyers used to ask us for spec sheets over email. Now they find them on the site and come to us ready to order.
The queues were gone in the first week. Students just upload, pay and pick up their prints.
Booking a workshop takes a minute now. More students sign up, and fewer drop off halfway.
New visitors just ask the assistant. Our team stopped answering the same questions all day.
Families see our finished homes before they call. Most enquiries now start on WhatsApp.
One trade goes to every client account at once. And no more monthly platform fees.
